title: Board Play Force Layout Play Pause And Settings Tab
description: Board play: add play/pause for force-layout tick loop in UI menu strip; move force layout numeric options to new Settings tab on right panel.
summary: Fixed zoom resetting during force-layout play by pinning triptych camera basis to a ref snapshot while playing (cameraBasisTick bumps only when pausing or on play-start). Replaced settings number inputs with Slider controls: iterations apply-once, ideal edge, repulsion, gravity, play interval, tick iterations—tighter defaults and repulsion slider for smaller spreads. boardPlayForceLayoutOpts now passes repulsionStrength to WASM.
